newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares fall by over two pct, poll rumours.
newsitem.headline: French shares fall by over two pct, poll rumours.

text.p: French shares extended their losses to more than two percent in late morning trade amid market talk that privately commissioned polls show the Socialists in the lead for Sunday's parliamentary election runoff, brokers said. The rumoured polls were not publicly available under French law.
* CAC-40 index down 53.26, or 1.99 percent, at 2,627.08 at 0935 GMT
* CAC-40 May futures 2,627 vs 2,679 at Tuesdays close.
* Of CAC-40 stocks, two higher, 38 lower, none unchanged.
